name: morph-surface

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the open card with the message actually typed in, the fullest form state.

tagline: A tiny pill grows into a small message box.
summary: A collapsed pill with a dot, a label and a Send Feedback prompt springs open into a rounded card holding a textarea and a cmd-Enter shortcut. Submitting folds it back and briefly flashes a tick.
appearance: At rest a wide rounded pill shows a white dot, the words Morph Surface and a muted Send Feedback prompt. Opened it becomes a taller rounded card, keeping the label at the top left, cmd and Enter keys at the top right, and a large text area below.
behaviour: Clicking the pill springs it open into the card and focuses the textarea. Escape or an outside click folds it back; cmd-Enter submits, after which the card closes and the dot shows a check for a moment.
demo_content: Prompt Send Feedback, placeholder "What's on your mind? We read every message.", plus a typed note.
search_phrases: feedback box that expands from a pill
small message form at the bottom
collapsed bar that opens a text box
inline comment box with a shortcut
compact note form for a website
use_when: You want a lightweight feedback or note box that stays a small pill until someone writes.
avoid_when: The message needs a subject or attachments: there is one textarea and no extra fields.
customise: triggerLabel, placeholder, submitLabel, the collapsed and expanded sizes, spring speed, callbacks and render functions for trigger, content and indicator are props.
weight_why: One spring-animated card and a textarea; no media or heavy rendering.

a11y.note: The textarea relies on its placeholder instead of a label, and the morph ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: The pill always shows the hardcoded words Morph Surface in front of your trigger label.
The textarea is labelled only by its placeholder, so its purpose is not announced.
polish_why: Satisfying pill-to-card spring; the stray Morph Surface label and unlabeled field cost a little.
